title: Radio station display and tuning issues
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on radio usability problems, especially missing station information, difficult station selection, and cases where the radio or reception does not work properly.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe radio reception failing, radio controls being distracting, and preset or channel-list access being very difficult.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the radio not turning on, weak or missing station display information, and awkward station switching, but the short fragments do not always make the overall sentiment explicit.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short, so many mention a radio issue without enough context to determine overall sentiment confidently.
One fragment is too vague to interpret on its own and does not clearly describe the radio topic.
This cluster is coherent around radio behavior and station display, but the evidence mixes reception, interface design, dashboard display, and voice-control issues.
